description: Lokuge Don Jayalath Pathmasiri v. Hon. Attorney General Lokuge Don Jayalath Pathmasiri v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. Deepali Wijesundera, J
parties: Lokuge Don Jayalath Pathmasiri v. Hon. Attorney General Lokuge Don Jayalath Pathmasiri v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: Criminal appeal – Sexual abuse of child – Four-year-old victim – Trial in absentia – Twelve years rigorous imprisonment – Fine and compensation – Competency of child witness – Evidence of victim corroborated by mother and medical evidence – No material contradictions going to root of prosecution case – Defence evidence failing to create reasonable doubt – High Court conviction affirmed – Appeal dismissed. L.U. Jayasuriya J. agreed.
legistation: Penal Code – section 365(2)(b)(2); Evidence Ordinance – provisions concerning competency of witnesses.
